dataformat.name: thrift
dataformat.title: Thrift
dataformat.description: Serialize and deserialize messages using Apache Thrift binary data format
dataformat.label: dataformat,transformation

marshalIn.description: An object of a class the Thrift compiler generated, as unmarshal gives. The body is not converted: other bodies fail

marshalOut.description: The Thrift binary data, or JSON with contentTypeFormat json or sjson, in the stream cache, or a byte array when stream caching is off

unmarshalIn.description: Thrift binary data, or with contentTypeFormat json the Thrift JSON protocol (field ids and types) as marshal writes it. sjson is for marshal only

unmarshalOut.description: An object of the class instanceClass names: unmarshal fails without it

instanceClass.description: Name of class to use when unmarshalling.

contentTypeFormat.description: The content type format in which thrift message will be serialized/deserialized. The format can be native binary, json, or simple json.

contentTypeHeader.description: Whether the data format should set the Content-Type header with the type from the data format. For example application/xml for data formats marshalling to XML, or application/json for data formats marshalling to JSON
